roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Built and evaluated agent framework prototypes using LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI, smolagents, and AutoGen; developed reusable patterns for routing, tool use, handoffs, and multi-agent orchestration.
Built a production FastAPI microservice to orchestrate tool-using AI agents, with a focus on reliable service integration and maintainable software design.

Designed and built a reusable synthetic-data generation framework with a domain-agnostic core and pluggable adapters, using structured LLM outputs and validation to support development and evaluation.
Contributed to the design and development of a GenAI evaluation and controls framework to support consistent assessment of LLM applications and agentic systems.
Designed adversarial and prompt-injection evaluations using synthetic data, and used targeted scenarios to assess model quality and refine prompts.
Developed reusable coding-agent skills for repeatable, agent-assisted engineering tasks.
Led cross-team delivery, owned technical design decisions, and communicated progress and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Designed a scalable Python framework and training scenarios for autonomous vehicle simulation.
Optimized CI/CD pipelines using Python, GitLab CI, and Docker to improve deployment efficiency and scenario updates.
Created automated testing frameworks with Jenkins and Python to reduce manual effort and shorten testing cycles.
Developed ML tools and CI/CD pipelines using NLP, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
Built a Python and Linux diagnostic tool to improve platform reliability.
Led technical projects and collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver against project requirements.

skills.Software engineering: Object-oriented programming, design patterns, FastAPI, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Pydantic, JWT, distributed systems
skills.AI / LLM engineering: LLM applications, agentic AI, RAG, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool-using agents, synthetic data, evaluation and controls, adversarial evaluation, prompt-injection testing, MCP
skills.Agent frameworks: LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, PydanticAI, smolagents, AutoGen
skills.Tools and cloud: Linux, Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Git, JIRA, Kibana, Grafana, Agile (Scrum), AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker
skills.Machine learning: NLP, Transformers, PyTorch, TensorFlow, PEFT / LoRA concepts, fine-tuning strategy, model evaluation and deployment

summary: Machine Learning Engineer focused on production GenAI, agentic systems, evaluation, and controls. Experienced in agent frameworks, backend services, synthetic data, adversarial evaluation, RAG/MCP tooling, and AWS Bedrock/SageMaker. Strong background in Python, distributed systems, CI/CD, and cross-team delivery.
